entities.name: English Marriage Act (Lord Hardwicke's)
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: The first law requiring marriages to be performed in church, by a licensed clergyman, with parental consent for those under 21. It ended secret marriages (like those at Fleet Prison) and clandestine elopements. Scotland's non-adoption created Gretna Green — the famous runaway wedding destination.
